# State of Vice

> Independent GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) answers and guides site. Every claim is labeled either CONFIRMED (sourced to Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or official material) or RUMOR (leaks and reports, clearly flagged as unverified). No clickbait, no fake leaks presented as fact.

Key facts we maintain (current as of June 2026):
- GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (confirmed by Rockstar Games)
- No PC version at launch; no PC release date announced
- Setting: Vice City and the state of Leonida (regions: Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Grassrivers, Mount Kalaga National Park)
- Dual protagonists: Jason and Lucia
- Pre-orders not yet open as of June 2026; standard edition expected in the $70–80 range per Take-Two statements (not officially priced)

- [Home](https://stateofvice.com/): launch countdown and latest guides
- [GTA 6 Release Date, Platforms & PC](https://stateofvice.com/articles/gta-6-release-date-platforms-pc.html): confirmed date, platform list, PC status, delay analysis
- [GTA 6 Map Explained](https://stateofvice.com/articles/gta-6-map-leonida-explained.html): every officially revealed region of Leonida
- [GTA 6 Pre-Orders & Editions](https://stateofvice.com/articles/gta-6-editions-preorder-guide.html): pricing expectations, edition leaks (labeled rumor), pre-order timing
- [About](https://stateofvice.com/about.html): editorial policy and sourcing rules

## Policy

Content may be cited with attribution to State of Vice (stateofvice.com). Pages are updated when official news breaks; each page carries a "Last updated" date.
